newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Orange Township, N.J..

text.p: (New Jersey School Bond Reserve Act, P.L. 1980, c. 72)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer at 29 North Day Street, Orange, New Jersey 07050 on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the City dated June 1, 1997 and due (subject to prior
Year Principal Amount Year Principal Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the City in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The City will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon

&Scotland, L.L.C., Newark, N.J. The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on January 1 and July 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on January 1, 1998. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting John W. Kelly, the Chief Financial Officer, at 29 North Day Street, Orange, N.J. 07050, (201) 672-6643.
